name: Scroll Warp Image List
description: Smooth-scrolled vertical list of large serif titles with WebGL image planes behind them that warp and RGB-split in response to scroll velocity, while titles drift sideways on scroll.
contents: Large ghost heading and small fixed heading label
List of entries, each with a subtitle, a big serif title and a WebGL image plane
behavior: GSAP ScrollSmoother smooths page scrolling inside the wrapper
Image planes follow their DOM images, tilted on a diagonal, and bend and RGB-shift with scroll velocity
Titles slide horizontally as each entry crosses the viewport
editableByProps: Entries, titles, subtitles, images and heading text
Scroll smoothing, warp strength, RGB shift, lerp speed and plane tilt
Background, text, label and ghost heading colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change plane group tilt or scale

fixed: Sets body and html overflow to auto while mounted and restores it on unmount
Takes over page scrolling with ScrollSmoother on the component wrapper
Appends a fixed fullscreen WebGL canvas that sizes to the window
Fixed heading label is hidden below the md breakpoint
